db:select.doc:name: Get product
db:select.db:sql: SELECT code, name, min_amount, max_amount, min_tenure_months, max_tenure_months, annual_rate_pct, min_age_at_application, max_age_at_application, max_age_at_maturity, emi_ceiling_pct, amount_step, active FROM products WHERE code = :code

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var p = payload[0] --- { code: p.code, name: p.name, minAmount: p.min_amount, maxAmount: p.max_amount, minTenureMonths: p.min_tenure_months, maxTenureMonths: p.max_tenure_months, annualRatePct: p.annual_rate_pct, minAgeAtApplication: p.min_age_at_application, maxAgeAtApplication: p.max_age_at_application, maxAgeAtMaturity: p.max_age_at_maturity, emiCeilingPct: p.emi_ceiling_pct, amountStep: p.amount_step, active: p.active }

db:select.doc:name: Check product
db:select.db:sql: SELECT code FROM products WHERE code = :code

db:select.doc:name: Get document rules
db:select.db:sql: SELECT doc_type, description, required_count, max_size_bytes, array_to_string(allowed_extensions, ',') AS allowed_extensions, array_to_string(allowed_mime_types, ',') AS allowed_mime_types FROM product_document_rules WHERE product_code = :code ORDER BY id

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { productCode: vars.code, rules: payload map (rule) -> { docType: rule.doc_type, description: rule.description, requiredCount: rule.required_count, maxSizeBytes: rule.max_size_bytes, allowedExtensions: rule.allowed_extensions splitBy ",", allowedMimeTypes: rule.allowed_mime_types splitBy "," } }

db:select.doc:name: Get active scorecard
db:select.db:sql: SELECT version, approve_min_score, refer_min_score, offer_validity_days FROM scorecard_versions WHERE active = TRUE LIMIT 1

db:select.doc:name: Get scorecard factors
db:select.db:sql: SELECT factor, weight, zero_points_at, full_points_at FROM scorecard_config WHERE version = :version ORDER BY factor

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var s = vars.scorecard[0] --- { version: s.version, approveMinScore: s.approve_min_score, referMinScore: s.refer_min_score, offerValidityDays: s.offer_validity_days, factors: payload map (f) -> { factor: f.factor, weight: f.weight, zeroPointsAt: f.zero_points_at, fullPointsAt: f.full_points_at } }
